title: a4-sa10: Analog Four MKII, OS 1.56 (UNRELEASED)
description: UNRELEASED: the A4 mod 0.10, never run on a real A4. A track's sound can pick a Sidecar machine, whose audio comes back through that voice's analog filters and amp. The same file elekloader builds from core-0.3.elemod + sidecar-a4-0.10.elemod with the lock file and version SA10 (sha256 2c180323...836fe0). Needs a Sidecar with the A4 pages.
